Geographies Served Programs Urban Livelihood Programme District Hyderabad Krishnagiri Jaipur Pune Nashik Akola Vadodara Ahmedabad Mumbai Chennai Gurgaon Solan Ahmednagar Medchal Malkajgiri State Puducherry Tamil Nadu Goa Gujarat Haryana Himachal Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Telangana District Hyderabad Krishnagiri Jaipur Pune Nashik Akola Vadodara Ahmedabad Mumbai Chennai Gurgaon Solan Ahmednagar Medchal Malkajgiri States Puducherry Tamil Nadu Goa Gujarat Haryana Himachal Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Telangana TNS India Foundation offers the Urban Livelihood Programme, upskilling under-resourced college youth in advanced technical, digital, and industrial skills, unlocking their economic potential. The programme includes Career Readiness, Counselling, Access, and Wrap-around support for holistic progress. It branches into three learning pathways: Campus to Corporate Careers (C2C), Campus to Technical Careers (C2TC), and Campus to Industrial Careers (C2IC). Additionally, the foundation aids urban women entrepreneurs through a high-touch business advisory programme, enhancing management capacity, tech-enabled processes, business models, and access to credit for operational scale-up and financial viability. Rural Livelihood Programme District Nashik Gir Somnath State Gujarat Maharashtra District Nashik Gir Somnath States Gujarat Maharashtra To address the challenges faced by farming households, TNS India Foundation has developed capacity building programs in Gujarat and Maharashtra to enhance crop yield, institutional strengthen and market linkages, water resource management for farming households etc. Gir Gujarat- Sustainable Mango Initiative aims at Sustainably improving the incomes of mango farming households by setting up a Farmer Producer Organization, providing training on good agronomy practices, developing market systems, creation of comm.on water resources and promoting household-level nutrition gardens in Gujarat.
